subject: Request: Invoice-only lane for MicroSpark subscription (micro-SaaS) - PO exemption proposal
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Invoice-only lane for MicroSpark subscription (micro-SaaS) - PO exemption proposal

Hi team,

Quick request on a small recurring SaaS piece we're trying to close with MicroSpark Labs (proof-of-concept for a dataset enrichment feature). The vendor doesn't support PO numbers on their checkout — they invoice monthly and accept ACH. Typical monthlies are low ($250 - $1,200) and this will be billed automatically.

Ask: Can Procurement/Finance approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding lane for MicroSpark under an internal cap and evidence checklist?

What I'm proposing:
- Eligibility: recurring SaaS subscriptions < $1,500/mo or $18k/yr
- Evidence required: vendor W9, standard T&Cs (attached), vendor bank details and reference check (Microspark already provided W9 + basic terms)
- Controls: 6-month trial cap of $5k cumulative; renewals require conversion to standard PO flow or escalation
- Owner: Sales to own vendor relationship; Procurement to record vendor in system; Finance to enable ACH invoice processing under the cap

Why: Sales needs a fast path for low-dollar recurring tools that block pilots; customers expect the vendor to invoice. Building a custom PO workaround adds weeks and kills momentum.

I can route the vendor docs (attached) if you want to review. If we need more risk controls, happy to propose a short checklist (data handling/scope).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Att: MicroSpark_Terms.pdf, MicroSpark_W9.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Invoice-only lane for MicroSpark subscription (micro-SaaS) - PO exemption proposal

Thanks for the summary — quick checklist from Procurement perspective:

1) Confirm vendor legal name + DBA (W9 matches?)
2) Confirm vendor bank details and ACH/Remittance instructions
3) Verify that service terms include standard liability limits and no unusual data residency clauses
4) Confirm single-point-of-contact + billing email

Assuming the docs check, we can approve a temporary "invoice-only: low-dollar" path but we need: a written confirmation of the $5k trial cap, a renewal review date locked in the vendor record, and an internal tag so this vendor is flagged for conversion to PO flow at renewal. Procurement will log the vendor and add the exception note.

Laura — can Legal do a 1-paragraph review on the attached T&Cs for any non-standard clauses?
David — do we have precedent for an ACH invoice path with a monthly auto-bill under a $5k trial cap?

- Karthik
Director, Procurement

From: Alex Chen <alex@microsparklabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MicroSpark onboarding docs

Marissa — thanks for flagging. Attached are the W9 and our standard terms (see attachments in the thread). A couple of notes to help Procurement/Finance:

- We bill monthly on the 1st via invoice, ACH payments accepted to the account on the W9.
- We don't issue PO acknowledgements; most customers pay via invoice.
- Liability limits are standard per the attached PDF; we can sign a short addendum but our legal team is small so turnaround could be 5 business days.

If it helps, we can accept a short onboarding email from Redwood confirming the $5k trial cap and billing cadence — that would be sufficient for us to proceed and start the trial.

Best,
Alex Chen
Head of Partnerships | MicroSpark Labs
[Attachment: MicroSpark_Terms.pdf, MicroSpark_W9.pdf]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Invoice-only lane for MicroSpark subscription (micro-SaaS) - PO exemption proposal

Marissa — I'm OK to approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for MicroSpark with the following conditions:

1) Trial cap confirmed at $5,000 cumulative for the initial 6 months (sales to track spend weekly).
2) MicroSpark must provide completed W9 and bank details (we have the W9 attached).
3) Legal confirms there are no high-risk clauses (Laura, please confirm).
4) Procurement (Karthik) to tag the vendor record as "Invoice-only - low-dollar - 6mo trial" and set a renewal review reminder for 2027-12-01.
5) Finance will enable ACH invoice processing and will require Sales to push any invoice > $1,500 for pre-approval via finance-redwood@.

If all of the above are in place, Finance gives provisional sign-off. Please cc billing@microsparklabs.com on the confirmation email to finalize their onboarding.

I'll resend this as a short approval note that Sales can send to MicroSpark.

-David
David Kim | Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal-approval-note.txt]
